notes.title: 0.2.1 update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090738/5b1b4e954892d8bcda294ef9cfc6a19c33d9ba21.png
Added new character Ice Guardian

8 new skills added
- Solid Iceberg
- Cold Blast
- Spiky Ice
- Thorn Attack
- Press
- Thorn Skin
- Shattered
- Offense and Defense

improvement
- Reduction of sound effect amplification
- Credits page skip function

bug fix
- Shadow Slash Skill: Fixed a bug where additional damage due to stacking curses was not applied

notes.title: 0.1.13 update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
- Intermittent enemy turns not progressing
- Fixed and optimized related monster AI logic

notes.title: 0.1.12 update
notes.content:
Improvements
Added the ability to re-view the Battle Guide in the top UI
Camping - Rest: You can now see how much health you're regaining
Camping - Search: Now shows which artifacts have been found

Bug fixes
- Fixed a bug where encountering consecutive shop tiles would not update.

notes.title: Bug Fixes & CameraShake settings on/off
notes.content:
Bug fixes
- Fixed an issue where damage calculation was weird in certain countries (may not be perfect yet).

Improvements
- Reduced camera shake slightly.
- You can now turn camera shake off and on in the Settings.

notes.title: bug fix
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug that caused dead enemy monsters to remain taunted

Improvements
- Reduced mouse wheel sensitivity

Under investigation
- Enemy turn progression freezing in certain situations is being checked

notes.title: Artifact & skill bug fixes
notes.content:
Bug fix
- Dead characters are now affected by artifacts.
- Plague skill's poison stack goes to 0.
- Skill buttons getting stuck at the end of the turn.
- Other minor bugs.

notes.title: skill bug fix
notes.content: Fixed a bug with the Prepare Ingredients skill.
